steps.name: Gang Member
steps.text: ...Just who are you, anyway?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Penguin Logistics.

steps.name: Gang Member
steps.text: So you're with that logistics company everyone's been buzzing about, the one that's got connections on both sides of the law.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: If you don't want to end up like your buddy lying over there, then get lost.

steps.name: Gang Member
steps.text: The dai lo won't let you get away with this.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: He can get in line behind everyone else coming after me. Tell your dai lo he'd better hurry up.

steps.name: Gang Member
steps.text: Hmph.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Place is cleaned up.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: The goods oughta be in the trunk of that car.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: What are the goods anyway? You still haven't told me.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: And who's the client?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: And most importantly, where is the stuff going?

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Client's Monster Siren Records.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: We're haulin' some stuff for a concert tonight.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Got it.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: As for what the stuff is—

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Texas, I been thinkin'...

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Whenever you say that, nothing good comes of it.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Look, we runnin' a company now, and the most important thing for a company is its corporate culture.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Corporate culture?

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Yeah, we gonna build our own corporate culture, startin' today.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: And today's keyword is—mystery.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: You mean, we're building this thing day-by-day?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Never mind.
By now, Texas has become somewhat used to the Emperor's unpredictability.
She shrugs, opens the trunk of the car, and freezes for a moment.
There's a girl inside, bound tightly with rope, her mouth taped shut. But that isn't what makes Texas freeze—after all, she's seen this scene plenty of times before.
No, it's because she recognizes the girl.
It's Sora, the pop idol who's become viral lately. Texas likes to listen to her songs when she drives.
As soon as Sora sees Texas, she gives a pleading look and begins to struggle.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: *muffled screams*!!!

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Settle down.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Agh! Look at my outfit! It's all wrinkled.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: *huff* Yeah, maybe I shouldn't be worrying about that right now.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Are you here to rescue me, or kill me?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Neither.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: I'm here to make a delivery.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Then you must be Texas, from Penguin Logistics, right?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: You know me?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: This delivery job was actually something I convinced my manager to give you.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: You knew you'd be kidnapped?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Yeah. There are some people who don't want me performing. They hired a gang to kidnap me.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: I happened to overhear their conversation.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Oh, right, I forgot to introduce myself. I'm Sora, an idol signed to Monster Siren Records.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: I know.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: I have your CD in my car.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Oh?! You're a fan?!

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: I have lots of your CDs, actually.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Thanks for your support!

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Can you move?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Let's go.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: I'll give you a lift to the concert hall.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Wait a minute. If I told you to take me somewhere else, would you?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: My job is to deliver the goods, that's you, to the concert hall.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: But you can tell me first.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Gimme a second.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Mic test, one two one two.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Can you feel the Arts?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Looks like the kidnappers really did break my mic.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Could you take me to a music store to get it fixed first?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: What's wrong?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: I thought you would want me to take you somewhere safe.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: I'm an idol. I have a responsibility to my fans.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Besides, tonight's concert is very important. If I mess it up, the company will be pissed.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Does it matter?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Does it not?

steps.name: Voice from Far Away
steps.text: Over there. She should be over here. Surround the area!

steps.name: Texas (in the car)
steps.text: Tell me where the music store is.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Will you take me there?

steps.name: Texas (in the car)
steps.text: The boss said the word of the day is 'mystery'. We're building a corporate culture, you know.

steps.name: Texas (in the car)
steps.text: So winging it seems pretty fitting for 'mystery' right now.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Texas, I saw the CDs in your car. You haven't bought my 'sleep aid' series, have you?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: I saw it in the store, but I haven't bought it yet.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: I sleep just fine.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: And besides, I probably don't need sleep aids when I'm driving.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: That's true.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: But I still highly recommend my sleep aid series.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: You can give it to your insomniac friends!

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Looks like you're pretty proud of those.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: I'm proud of all my music!

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: I guarantee the sleep aid series will have you snoozing on your pillow!

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Unless, of course, you cover your ears. Then it may not be as effective.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Next time I can't sleep, I'll give it a try.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Oh, right. We should exchange contact info.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: I'll just send you one for free.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Compliments of rescuing me from the gang's evil clutches.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Thanks.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: I'm the one who should be thanking you.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Alright. We're here.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Give me a sec. I'll be out in real quick.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Okay.

steps.name: Gang Member A
steps.text: I found her! She's over here!

steps.name: Gang Member B
steps.text: Get her! Be careful! She's a tricky one!

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: *sigh* They never learn, do they?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Allow me.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Cover your ears, Texas!
Texas knows what's coming. She quickly covers her ears.
She sees Sora hop onto an adjacent balcony from the second floor of the music store and begins singing into her microphone.

steps.name: Gang Member A
steps.text: Kill that gir.... huh? I feel... funny.

steps.name: Gang Member B
steps.text: My eyes are so heavy...

steps.name: Gang Member C
steps.text: What a nice song. I feel... sleepy... g'night... zzzzzz
After Sora starts singing, the gangsters fall to the floor and drift off into a deep sleep.
Texas feels relieved, but quickly realizes it's because of Sora's singing.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: ...Something's not right.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: One time, when I was little, I got really annoyed and sang at the top of my lungs. Somehow, all the kids who heard me got angry too...

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: That's when I knew my singing could 'influence' people.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: If I have a strong thought in my mind and don't try to suppress it, it comes out in my song, and I can't guarantee who it might affect.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Sorry, Texas.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: I know you're very capable, which is why I had to lead you to believe...

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: That you could block my song by covering your ears.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Of course, that's not true.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Wh-Why did you?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: So I could get away from all of this.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: I'm so sorry.
You should apologize... to yourself.
After all, you've just sealed your own fate.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: How are you—

steps.name: Sinister Gang Member
steps.text: Your Arts are unique.

steps.name: Sinister Gang Member
steps.text: All it took was a little bit of digging to find that out.

steps.name: Sinister Gang Member
steps.text: But those idiots thought dealing with a 'little singer' would be easy. Now I can swoop in and get all the credit.

steps.name: Sinister Gang Member
steps.text: This crossbow ain't a toy, missy. If you don't wanna die, I suggest you stay put.

steps.name: Sinister Gang Member
steps.text: But there's no need to be scared. The higher-ups want you alive.

steps.name: Sinister Gang Member
steps.text: And I have to thank you too. That Texas from Penguin Logistics has been making a real name for herself lately. I don't think I could've taken her alone.

steps.name: Sinister Gang Member
steps.text: 'Get away from all of this.' Ha!

steps.name: Sinister Gang Member
steps.text: You privileged kids really do have some funny ideas, that's for sure.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: You don't get it.

steps.name: Sinister Gang Member
steps.text: You're right. I don't. You've got such a great life, singing and dancing for money, and getting all that attention.

steps.name: Sinister Gang Member
steps.text: And yet, you want to throw that life away, by the hands of a gangster no less.

steps.name: Sinister Gang Member
steps.text: I'd start regretting if I were you.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: I'm stupid... I admit it.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: From the start, I kept imagining all the ways I might fail, but I guess I underestimated you and ended up giving away my only chance of being saved.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: The reason I failed is kinda funny, even to me.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: But... if 'a good life' means singing the songs you're told, saying the words you're given, following the set schedule, and smiling on command every single day...

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: I rather throw it away.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: And the only thing I regret now is not having prepared better.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: But for trying to escape this life? I have no regrets.

steps.name: Sinister Gang Member
steps.text: You're bold, I'll give you that.

steps.name: Sinister Gang Member
steps.text: Don't worry. You'll get what you wish for.
That's not up to you.

steps.name: Sinister Gang Member
steps.text: What?!

steps.name: Sinister Gang Member
steps.text: Guh—

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Texas, you—

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: This isn't the best place for a chat.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Let's go.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: This should be far enough.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Texas...

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Your lullaby really is something.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: I almost didn't wake up.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: You're the first person who's ever woken up that quickly.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: I used to always be alert, paying attention to everything around me. I guess it's become a habit now.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Sorry, Texas.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: You already apologized.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Could you be a little angrier? Otherwise, I feel kinda bad...

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: You have no regrets, and so, I have no reason to be angry.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Ah, haha, you heard me say that.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: And I don't think there's anything wrong with it.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Really?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: You don't like your current life and want to get away from it. There's really nothing wrong with that.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: But like you said, next time you should prepare better.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: *sigh* If someone had told me what you just did, maybe I would have changed my mind.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Really? But I was encouraging you to escape.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: You don't get it.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Sometimes, just having someone who understands can stop you from doing something reckless.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: If I had met you earlier, I could've opened up to you about all the things that were bothering me.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: And maybe you would've comforted me, talked smack with me about the people who were bad to me.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: I'm not one for talking smack, but I could just smack them for you.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Well then I would have stopped you. I'm against violence!

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: We might have differing philosophies, but at least now I have someone to talk to.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Actually, this is exactly what I've been looking for.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: If I had a friend like you in the beginning, I would never have done this.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: It's getting late.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Yeah...

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: But before I leave, could you put on a show with me?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: I don't know how.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: I'll do the singing. You just need to ask the questions.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: And you'll know which questions to ask.
Sora walks under a streetlight and holds up her microphone. She extends her hand to Texas and invites her to come forward.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: There once was a girl who lived in a high-rise in Lungmen.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Left alone in her big, empty home, she learned how to sing from the idols on TV.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: From morning to night, from dusk to dawn...

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Music was her only friend.
Texas knows her songs from listening to them while she drives. She always thought they were nice.
However, at this moment, as Texas listens to Sora's singing, she hears not just the usual beauty in her voice, but also the vitality.
That forceful, explosive vitality.
She feels compelled to start speaking.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: What about her parents?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Her father is a businessman. Her mother is a C-list celebrity.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Their marriage was a spur-of-the-moment decision, and their careers are both so demanding.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: How could they have room to love that which was born, unexpectedly, from impulse?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Did she start singing because she was lonely?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: At first, she sang to express her loneliness.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Later, she learned to express more emotions through song.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Singing isn't her crutch, it's her companion.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: How did she become an idol?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: She didn't want to sing to an empty room.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: She wanted people to hear her songs...

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: So she left her home and went to the garden downstairs.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: The neighbor's kids were playing. She stood in between them and started singing.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Her singing attracted other children, as well as their parents.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: That's how she was discovered.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Did she want to be a pop idol?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Everyone was so happy.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Her parents no longer needed to worry about their daughter's future. They had one less burden.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: And Monster Siren Records had a new star.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: The girl was also very happy, at the time.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: She loved singing to her bones.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: She wanted more people to hear her songs.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: But things didn't always go her way.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Yes! Yes!

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Thank you, everyone, for coming to my show!

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: I'll be bringing you all even more amazing performances in the future. Please continue to support me!

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: I'm very happy to meet you all. I hope you can come to my next show!

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: This is the script she has to repeat every time.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: She has more she wants to say.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: She has more songs she wants to sing.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Why didn't she tell that to the person around her?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: She already told them, but it didn't do any good.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: They all told her, 'That's the price you pay for being an idol.'

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: She doesn't hate them. They love her and care for her.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: But she also does hate them, because they've never really cared about her feelings.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: They only treat her well because—

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: She is following the path they chose for her.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: So she decided to run away.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: When she told her manager, her manager said it was common in the industry.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: That's when she decided...

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: She might as well disappear.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: But she loves the stage.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: It lets more people hear her songs.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: She loves the attention.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: She just wants to be heard.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: What are her true hopes and dreams?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: She's only ever had one true dream—

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: To be able to sing...

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: as a free soul...

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Without a care in the world!
The riverwalk is empty.
Her only audience is the bright moon, the cool breeze, and Texas.
But Sora has a huge smile on her face.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Thank you, Texas

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: For helping me fulfill my wish.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Take me to the concert, please.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: No, I'm gonna take you back to the Penguin Logistics office.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: This...

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Yes. The Penguin Logistics office.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: I have other orders to deliver.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: You can stay here for as long as you like.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Is this gonna be a problem for you with Monster Siren Records?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Yeah, but it's not a big deal.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Why... did you help me?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Last year, I decided to leave Columbia, but I didn't know where to go.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Back then, someone took me to Lungmen, to this very room.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: They told me I could stay here for as long as I liked.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: And then you just stayed?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: And then, we founded Penguin Logistics.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: You're saying you were like me? You wanted to run away from your past?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Run away from it? No.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: I was just tired of it.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Same as you're tired of being held back by all those rules.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: But you're so strong.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: My sword can't solve everything.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: After hearing you say all that, I know we should've found each other a long time ago.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: You could have encouraged me...

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: And I could have encouraged you.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: It's not too late.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Do you mean to say that we're friends now?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: I don't have many friends, so I'm not really sure.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Now that you mention it, I don't have many people around me that I can call friends either.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: But, we've already shared a bit of our past with each other. Usually, only friends talk about that stuff, right?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: True...

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Then that settles it. We are friends!

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: You can call me Sora.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Okay, Sora.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Texas, where you at?!

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: (Whisper) I'll make myself scarce.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: (Whisper) It's fine.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: I'm at the office.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Don't you got deliveries to make?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Something came up, so no.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: (Whisper) Should you really be that blunt?!

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Aight. Word of the day is 'mystery' n' all.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: That's a mysterious answer, so we good!

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Oh, right, almost forgot the important thing.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: (Whisper) I'm not the 'important thing'?!

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: What'choo doin' right now?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: About to deliver an order.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Scratch that. Our keyboard player just had a bad breakup n' vanished. You're on the keyboard!

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Usual place?

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: You know it.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Okay.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Gotta go.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: You rest here.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: If you want to leave, that's fine too. Just make sure to pull the door down from the outside. Thanks.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Wait.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Can I go with you?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Are you afraid of the dark? I'll turn on a light for you.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: I'm the one who caused all this trouble. I should go tell Emperor, personally.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: That works.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Boss, I'm here.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Yeah, just in time.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Mr. Emperor, sir....

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Texas, when you said 'something came up', was you talkin' about this shawty?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: She didn't want to go, so I didn't take her.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Oh, aight.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: That's it? Just 'aight'?

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: What? Decided you wanna go now?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Then you don't go. I'll handle Monster Siren Records.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Thank you... Mr. Emperor.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Cool. Texas, go get ready. I'mma 'bout to take the stage.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Okay.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Texas, you can play an instrument?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Yeah. Boss forced me to learn a few.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: He's always saying a good Messenger has to play a musical instrument, so I did.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Personally, I like the cello.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Haha! I'd love to see you play the cello.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Next time maybe.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Hey, can I ask you how you left? Columbia, I mean.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Did you do what I did and just leave everything behind, all of a sudden?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: I started a fire, ki... fought some people, and told everyone to stay away from me.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Will they listen?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: They will. They know who I am, so they won't come looking for me.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Although, it seems one of them still hasn't given up yet.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Well, did you do it?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Do what?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Did you really escape your past?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Since I left, I've only been certain about one thing—

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: One day, my past will catch up to me.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Why?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Because I grew up in that world.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: The ties I have with it can't be severed by any sword.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: It's like rainwater flowing into the drain, then the river. But eventually, it evaporates and becomes rain again.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: You mean running away is pointless?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: No. It got me to Lungmen, to your songs. It made us friends.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: And I've come to realize that delivering packages isn't nearly as easy as I thought.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: So when your past does catch up to you, what will you do then?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: I'll cross that bridge when I come to it.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: That's all?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Yeah. That's all.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Pfft!

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: What's wrong?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Nothing. It's just that... I feel like so many of my problems suddenly melted away.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: You ready, Texas?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Yeah.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Aight...

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Emperor, I took a look at the set list. Can I join you for the next one, please?

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Oh? You wanna try one of my legendary tracks for yourself?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: You may not know, but I've been practicing my rapping. I've perfected my flow.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: It's just that the label never gives me a chance to rap.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Naw, I know.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Our recording studios are pretty damned close, c'mon.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: So... what do you think of my rapping?

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: I think I can take this song, and this stage, and hand 'em right off to you.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Thanks!

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: I only got one condition.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Bring the house down, right?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Leave it to me!

steps.name: Audience Member A
steps.text: Hey! Shouldn't Emperor be on vocals? What's that girl doing onstage?

steps.name: Audience Member B
steps.text: She looks familiar. Wait, it's Sora, from Monster Siren Records!

steps.name: Audience Member C
steps.text: What's she doing here? Can she even rap?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Everyone is so surprised.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: I'm even more surprised you can do one of boss's songs.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: I'm a professional, I'll have you know.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: And also...

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: I've changed my mind, Texas.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: After I finish this one, can you take me to the concert hall?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: I should still be able to make it.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Are you sure?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Yeah, I'm sure.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Hello everyone. Today I will be performing an Emperor classic.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Some of you may know me, and some of you may not. It's fine either way.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Just remember to get on your feet and make some noise!

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Because tonight, we're tearing the roof down!

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Alright. This is far enough.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: From here on, I'll go it alone.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: You don't need my help?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: This is my business, and I'll handle it.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Thank you, Texas.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: You already thanked me.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: One thank you is not enough.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: You saved my life; you listened to me. Plus, you told me—

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: That even if I'm going to leave, I should tell everyone what kind of person I am.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Now that I think about it, if I just up and left, everyone would just think of me as 'that teen idol.' That's not the legacy I want for myself.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: I just never had the courage to face up to it before.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Now I do.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Okay, I'm going now.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: If you run into any trouble, just give me a call.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Of course!

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Damn, she leaves one helluva impression.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: I'm thinkin' her path to true stardom starts right here.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Boss, you chose 'mystery' as the word of the day because you never intended to complete the Monster Siren Records job, right?

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: From where I'm standin', looks to me like we got the job done?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: If this is what counts as done, I think our clients aren't going to be too happy.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Alright. I've solved today's 'mystery'. You're the one who called in the job.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Me?

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Naw, you got this all twisted, Texas.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Sora's deep yearnin' for freedom put out the job.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Now, think about it, you know what the real job is, don't you?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Yeah, I do.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Monster Siren Records wanted us to 'deliver Sora to the stage.'

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: But the job I was assigned was...

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: To 'deliver the true Sora to the stage.'
The concert that night would later be immortalized by Sora's fans.
Sora, the idol, steps onto the stage and completely changes her style. She sings a variety of songs that clash with her usual image, ranging from folk to rap, and everything in between.
The band initially thinks this is a surprise sanctioned by the record company, so they play along with Sora for several songs.
Soon, the record company intervenes and tells them to stop, but Sora continues singing acapella.
'That was the most passionate voice I've ever heard on this great land.'
'What I heard was endless love, for music, for us, for freedom!'
—Commentary from one of the audience members.
However, after the performance, Monster Siren Records immediately blames Sora for the 'incident'. They threaten to terminate her for 'deliberately sabotaging' the show.
Despite mounting criticism, the usually meek Sora fights back with an unexpected toughness.
She refuses to apologize or admit her mistakes, putting both sides at a temporary impasse.
At this point, Emperor, renowned musician and also a producer signed to Monster Siren Records, steps in.
He states that his company, Penguin Logistics, will take Sora in until she can resume public life.
The Emperor's guarantee quickly smooths things over. For the time being, Sora decides to join Penguin Logistics as a Messenger.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Hmm... hmmhmm...♫

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Hey, Texas, have you heard my new song yet?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Yeah. It's pretty good.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: That's all you have to say about it?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: I'd like some more detailed feedback, please.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Let me listen to it a few more times.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Okay.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: We got a new job. Which one of you's takin'?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Me! I'll go!

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Aight, you got this one, Sora.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Don't you go doing what you did last time, singin' for your fans n' forgettin' the job.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Don't worry, I won't!

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Boss, after I deliver this one, can I go record another song?

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Aight.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Thanks, boss!

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Keep an eye on 'er, Texas.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Okay.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Heh, put those two together, and it's gonna be straight fire.
